meta.method: Extracted all proposals from 7 AARs (M1, M2, M4, M5, M6, M7, M9), ranked by cross-AAR convergence, grouped by target harness artifact

convergenceRanking.summary: Replace blanket .aitools/ in root .gitignore with selective patterns. Also create .aitools/.gitignore for multi-project deployment. This is the ROOT CAUSE BLOCKER — three rules agree running estimates should be tracked but .gitignore defeats all three. Every carry-forward, channel, and running-estimate proposal depends on this.
convergenceRanking.bestFormulation: M4-P1 (both gitignore strategies) + M4-P4 (verification of pattern completeness)

convergenceRanking.targetArtifact: Running estimate schema, channel-init.sh, reconciliation algorithm
convergenceRanking.summary: Each session writes its running estimate to .aitools/channel/session-XXX/running-estimate.json (gitignored). Carry-forward estimate at .aitools/channel/running-estimate.json (tracked). Reconciliation at session end/start/handoff using LAST-UPDATED-WINS for scalars, UNION for arrays, MOST-ADVANCED-STATUS for enums.

convergenceRanking.theme: Fix .current-session pointer race condition for concurrent sessions
convergenceRanking.summary: SessionEnd hook must use session_id from Claude Code hook input JSON to find session directory, NOT from .current-session file. Change scratch-init.sh to use CC session_id as directory suffix (deterministic, reconstructable). .current-session becomes convenience-only, not authoritative.
convergenceRanking.leverage: HIGH — prevents data loss in concurrent sessions
convergenceRanking.handoffWave: Not in original handoff waves — NEW

convergenceRanking.theme: Harvest before destroying stale scratch directories
convergenceRanking.summary: scratch-init.sh stale-dir cleanup (rm -rf dirs >24h) currently destroys files without harvesting. Add opportunistic harvesting before deletion. This is the confirmed root cause of the 30 lost files from session Z1IhGrcgGO.
convergenceRanking.bestFormulation: M1-P4 (full specification) + M6-P3 (confirmed by recovery investigation)
convergenceRanking.effort: HIGH (requires extracting classification logic into shared function)
convergenceRanking.leverage: HIGH — prevents data loss from crashed sessions
convergenceRanking.handoffWave: Not in original handoff waves — NEW

convergenceRanking.summary: harvest-session.sh copies files to harvesting/ but never runs git add/commit. Harvested files sit as untracked in working tree — another session's stale cleanup or user's git clean destroys them. Auto-commit after harvest. Combined with P4, this closes both destruction paths.
convergenceRanking.leverage: HIGH — closes Phase 2 failure mode (harvest fires but files not committed)
convergenceRanking.handoffWave: Not in original handoff waves — NEW

convergenceRanking.targetArtifact: Planning brief (decision amendment), reference/orchestration-patterns.md, /handoff SKILL.md, delegation duty
convergenceRanking.summary: The 40-agent session demonstrated 5 orchestration patterns (WRITE-VERIFY-AMEND, PARALLEL-INVESTIGATE, S2-CHAIN, S2-THEN-S3, WRITE_BLOCKED-RELAUNCH) but these were never codified. The current session proved a cold-start S3 does not independently derive them. Root cause: Mission Command framework governs individual delegations but not composition into workflows. Fix: (1) codify patterns in planning brief, (2) add PATTERN-CHECK as delegation duty component 10, (3) create reference/orchestration-patterns.md, (4) extend dashboard schema with chain metadata, (5) add orchestration briefing to /handoff.
convergenceRanking.bestFormulation: M9-P1 (planning brief amendment) + M9-P4 (reference file) + M9-P3 (delegation duty extension)
convergenceRanking.handoffWave: Not in original handoff waves — NEW (operational learning from this session)

convergenceRanking.theme: Three-tier skill taxonomy with reference cards
convergenceRanking.summary: Formalize three skill tiers: (1) Project-only (full CRUD on registries, aitools repo only), (2) User-level (portable to any repo), (3) Reference-card (derived from project skills at build time, read-only knowledge deployed everywhere). Use /aitool-* prefix for user-level skills (commander chose this). Commander-selected: all user skills get prefix uniformly.
convergenceRanking.bestFormulation: M5-P3 (uniform prefix) + M5-P7 (three-tier taxonomy) + M5-P6 (reference card for tool-ops)
convergenceRanking.effort: HIGH (rename all shared/skills/, update build, migration path)
convergenceRanking.handoffWave: Not in original handoff waves — NEW

convergenceRanking.summary: PreToolUse hook on Write/Edit detects when agent writes carry-forward state (running-estimate.json, etc.) to .scratch/ and emits warning. Also update harvest-session.sh to recognize 'operational-state' as distinct artifact type.
convergenceRanking.leverage: MEDIUM — prevention layer for scratch misuse
convergenceRanking.handoffWave: Not in original handoff waves — NEW

convergenceRanking.summary: Add mock-session-lifecycle verification type to test harvest-session.sh end-to-end. The .json harvest path has never been tested (0 of 60 artifacts). Test creates temp session dir, runs hook, verifies classification.
convergenceRanking.handoffWave: Not in original handoff waves — NEW

convergenceRanking.summary: Record scratch-dir-to-CC-UUID mapping persistently for post-mortem recovery. M7 proved the methodology works (30/30 files recovered from transcripts). Append UUID + scratch-dir-name + timestamp to .scratch/.session-history at session start.
convergenceRanking.bestFormulation: M6-P4 (mapping persistence) validated by M7 (100% recovery rate)
convergenceRanking.leverage: MEDIUM — enables recovery when other mechanisms fail
convergenceRanking.handoffWave: Not in original handoff waves — NEW

conflictAnalysis.conflict: Gitignore strategy: root vs nested vs both
conflictAnalysis.resolution: M4-P1 wins — use both. Root .gitignore fix for aitools repo immediately, nested .aitools/.gitignore as template for other projects. M4-P1 subsumes M2-P3.
conflictAnalysis.rationale: Multi-project use case (grizzlies, customers) requires nested .gitignore so aitools doesn't modify project root .gitignore. Root fix needed NOW for aitools repo.

conflictAnalysis.conflict: Skill naming: selective prefix vs uniform prefix
conflictAnalysis.resolution: M5-P3 wins — commander chose uniform /aitool-* prefix for all user skills.
conflictAnalysis.rationale: Commander explicitly stated preference. Consistency > optimization.

conflictAnalysis.conflict: Harvest auto-commit: at SessionEnd vs at SessionStart (for stale dirs)
conflictAnalysis.resolution: Both needed — they address different failure modes. SessionEnd commit addresses Phase 2 failure (hook fires, files not committed). SessionStart harvest-before-delete addresses Phase 1 failure (hook never fires).
conflictAnalysis.rationale: Defense in depth. Two deletion paths need two safety nets.
